description: This PHP source file defines a class 'QuickLaunchAPI' within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides an API endpoint for retrieving quick launch shortcut settings for the dashboard, indicating which shortcuts are active or accessible based on user roles. It implements methods for fetching data, validation rules, and intentionally unimplemented methods for creating and deleting resources.
